# 2one Design Language System

> shadcn/ui components re-skinned to the 2one design tokens. Grayscale, light-only,
> pill buttons, Satoshi headings + Inter body. Structured for humans and AI.

## Start here
- [Agent guide](AGENTS.md): how to work in this repo
- [Registry](registry.json): component set, theme map, conventions, overrides

## Components
- Source: src/components/ui/<name>.tsx (54 shadcn primitives, 2one-themed)
- 2one-only: src/components/{logo,app-bar,bottom-nav-item}.tsx
- Names: shadcn (Input, Select, RadioGroup, InputOTP, DropdownMenu, …)
- Published as: @yokesh-2one/design-library

## Theme
- src/styles/globals.css — 2one tokens → shadcn CSS variables (light only)
- Fonts: Satoshi (headings), Inter (body). Icons: lucide.
- danger/success are the only hues, reserved for validation.

## Add a component
- npx shadcn@latest add <component>   (config in components.json)
